title: Seas the Day | Gulf View Seagrove Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Seas the Day is a pet-friendly 30A retreat with Gulf views, balconies, bikes, and community pools—just steps to the beach and minutes from Seaside.
description_expanded: Seas the Day Chic Gulf-View Retreat Just Steps to the Sand Home Introduction Unwind in style at Seas the Day , a beautifully designed four-bedroom retreat nestled in a quiet 30A neighborhood. With Gulf views, two nearby beach accesses, and two community pools just steps away, this home offers the perfect blend of relaxation, comfort, and coastal adventure. Home Highlights Gulf Views - Enjoy views from both the second and third floors Pet Friendly - Up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, non-shedding breeds only (approval and fee required) Community Pools - Chelsea Loop pool just 70 steps away plus Ryan Street Pool (heated March 1 through December 1, subject to HOA changes) Beach Proximity - 2-minute stroll to Ramsgate Beach Access with beach service available Scenic Access - 4-minute stroll to Eastern Lake Beach Access where the lake meets the Gulf Taxi Bikes - 4 Taxi bikes included and professionally maintained Outdoor Living - Gulf-facing balconies with seating plus gas grill Spacious Living Area - Open concept living room with large TV and Gulf views Full Kitchen - Located on second floor with Keurig and drip coffee makers Dining Space - Table seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 Smart TVs and WiFi - Streaming services available throughout the home (no cable) Washer and Dryer - Located on first floor Parking - Driveway space for 2 sedans or 1 oversized vehicle (no street parking, no RVs or trailers) Golf Cart Policy - Golf carts are not permitted per HOA rules Location Perks 2-minute bike ride to Greenway Station featuring shopping and dining 2-minute bike ride to The Perfect Pig, a local favorite restaurant 12-minute bike ride to Seaside for shopping, dining, and entertainment Less than 1 mile to Yellowfin Ocean Sports for fishing gear, kayaks, and paddleboard rentals Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10 days or longer (included in your stay) Additional cleanings can be scheduled for an extra fee Street parking is not allowed and strictly enforced No golf carts permitted within the neighborhood Concierge services available for bike rentals, grocery delivery, beach bonfires, paddleboard rentals, and baby equipment Home Overview If you are ready to truly "Seas the Day," this home delivers the ultimate coastal escape. Professionally designed with a chic and inviting aesthetic, this property offers both comfort and style just steps from the beach and two neighborhood pools. The main living area on the second floor features an open-concept layout with a spacious living room, dining area, and full kitchen. Relax on the plush sectional while taking in Gulf views just beyond. Step out onto the balcony to enjoy coastal breezes and outdoor seating. Upstairs, the third-floor king suite and queen guest room both offer stunning Gulf views. The king suite is a private retreat with a spa-like bathroom, jetted tub, walk-in shower, and its own balcony with Adirondack seating-perfect for morning coffee or evening sunsets. Whether you are lounging by the pool, biking to nearby hotspots, or enjoying sunset views from the balcony, Seas the Day is your perfect 30A getaway. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
